# Pikafish runtime provenance

Unmodified engine assets and matching NNUE: [pikafish-wasm v0.1.0](https://github.com/brianhliou/pikafish-wasm/releases/tag/v0.1.0). The Worker is from the same tag.

Exact engine source: [Pikafish 6a59ee2f7b105bff64d9efc2692591107787e2b1](https://github.com/official-pikafish/Pikafish/tree/6a59ee2f7b105bff64d9efc2692591107787e2b1).
Corresponding [source patch](https://github.com/brianhliou/pikafish-wasm/blob/v0.1.0/source.patch), [build script](https://github.com/brianhliou/pikafish-wasm/blob/v0.1.0/build.sh) and [rebuild instructions](https://github.com/brianhliou/pikafish-wasm/tree/v0.1.0#rebuild); toolchain emscripten/emsdk:3.1.74. Use the matching network from the fixed release.

Code: GPL-3.0-or-later, see LICENSE. NNUE weights: separate NNUE-License.md, prohibiting commercial use without permission. Retain licenses and exact source/build references when redistributing.
